check_ins.text: Morning update: today's calendar events and the next few days; then every reminder still pending, each with its day and time (or say there are none); then one line that she can change, move or stop any reminder by tapping the link below
Afternoon nudge: water again, and only what fits today: work or a task she mentioned, anything due soon, an evening plan or class
Midday nudge: whether she has drunk water, and only what fits today: a meeting, plan or workout class coming up later, or something she said she had to do
